summary: World Acceptance Corp. filed an 8-K regarding a $15 million accordion increase to its existing revolving credit facility with Bank of Montreal as administrative agent. The increase brings aggregate commitments from $640 million to $655 million, with Investar Bank providing the new commitment. The terms (interest rate, maturity, security) remain unchanged from the original facility. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation event. No change of control, activist activity, or strategic pivot is involved.
